title: Poll component data
description: Poll. question and options are the poll config (owner and admin only); closed true stops voting. Votes are vote_<publicKey> keys whose value is an option id ('' means no vote), and you can only write your own. Like chat, polls are shown in their own view, never as a card, and sit at index 9000 so reorders do not touch them; order polls by component id (uuidv7, creation time), not by index.

v.description: Wire format version, written by the app. Absent means 1.

question.description: The poll question. Example: "Where do we eat?".

_title.description: Panel title shown above the component. '' clears it. Example: "Groceries".

_sectionBreak.description: true starts a new visual section, with a bigger gap above and a stronger separator.

_width.description: Preferred width in logical pixels. Default 600, minimum 300.

_spaceAbove.description: Legacy spacing above in pixels, no longer written. When _sectionBreak is absent, a value of 16 or more reads as a section break.

_spaceBelow.description: Legacy spacing below in pixels, no longer written.

^vote_.+$.description: One vote per member, key vote_<publicKey>. The value is an option id, '' means no vote. You can only write the key ending in your own public key. Votes are blocked for everyone while closed is true. Example: "a".

^_.description: Other layout and UI keys starting with _. Any value.

id.description: Option id, referenced by votes. Example: "a".

label.description: Text shown for the option. Example: "Pizza".
